newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: C-C AMATIL SAYS CAN MANAGE PESO DOWNTURN.
newsitem.headline: C-C AMATIL SAYS CAN MANAGE PESO DOWNTURN.

text.p: Soft drinks bottler Coca-Cola Amatil Ltd said on Thursday that its currency management should minimise any effects from the depreciation of the Philippine peso on its full year earnings in calendar 1997.
C-C Amatil managing director Norb Cole told a Securities Insitute of Australia luncheon the company had long experience in the management of currency issues.
"At this time we expect our currency management programmes to minimise any effect of depreciation of the Philippine's peso on 1997 earnings," he said.
He said the recent cycle of currency volatilities was still unresolved, but he expected the value of the peso to stabilise given the positive outlook for the Philippine's economy.

C-C Amatil has become exposed to movements in the peso following its acquisition of the soft drink bottling operations of San Miquel Corp which was incorporated in the company's half year accounts from April 3 this year.
